gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-reconnected-primary:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconnected-primary:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reconnected-primary:a: Directly refuted: "The enabled mark still holds the old one, and the pool compares the two with ==, so the old sign-on no longer counts."
recorded.prompt:q-reconnected-primary:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconnected-primary:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reconnected-primary:c: Directly refuted: the pool "stopped using the link anyway" after the reconnect, and "a reconnect takes the link out until it signs on again."
recorded.prompt:q-reconnected-primary:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconnected-primary:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reconnected-primary:d: Directly refuted: primary-secondary "failback has no hold-down period", and the link is skipped because of the stale mark, not because of a timer.
recorded.prompt:q-round-robin-share:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-round-robin-share:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-round-robin-share:b: Refuted by one short inference: members are "looked up ... once at initialisation", and the page speaks of the pool skipping a member, so the unusable member stays in the list and is never removed.
recorded.prompt:q-round-robin-share:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-round-robin-share:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-round-robin-share:c: Directly refuted: the simpler rule that "would give -c both its own turn and -b's" is the one the 2.1.7 pool avoids.
recorded.prompt:q-round-robin-share:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-round-robin-share:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-round-robin-share:d: Refuted by one short inference: in the "round-robin, -b down" output host-mux and -c "got three requests each", so the first member gets no extra share.
recorded.prompt:q-split-member-down:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-split-member-down:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-split-member-down:b: Directly refuted: the requests went round-robin to the other two, "one each", not all to the first member.
recorded.prompt:q-split-member-down:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-split-member-down:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-split-member-down:c: Directly refuted: the terminal lands on its member only "while that member is usable", and otherwise its requests go round-robin and are answered.
recorded.prompt:q-split-member-down:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-split-member-down:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-split-member-down:d: Directly refuted: "its requests went round-robin to the other two", so nothing is refused and no exception is thrown.
recorded.prompt:q-nothing-usable:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-nothing-usable:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-nothing-usable:a: Directly refuted: "It checks the deadline only after the sleep, so a 200 ms request returns after a whole second."
recorded.prompt:q-nothing-usable:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-nothing-usable:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-nothing-usable:c: Directly refuted: the output shows "hosts received 0", and the reference table says "nothing sent", so no member's queue holds the message.
recorded.prompt:q-nothing-usable:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-nothing-usable:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-nothing-usable:d: Directly refuted: the reference table says the blocking request(m, timeout) "returns null", while only send and the asynchronous request throw.
